title: Almond Croissant French Toast Bake
changes_from_base: Torn shop-bought croissants replace sliced brioche, soaked in an almond-scented single cream custard under flaked almonds and baked as one dish rather than fried slice by slice.
summary: Buttery croissant pieces baked in a rich almond custard until golden, finished with a dusting of icing sugar and maple syrup.

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Prepare
steps.text: Lightly oil a 20 cm square baking dish and tear 6 croissants into 5-6 pieces each, spreading them evenly inside.

steps.title: Whisk
steps.text: Beat 4 eggs with 105 g brown sugar, 1 tsp vanilla, 1 tsp almond flavouring and ⅛ tsp salt, then whisk in 480 ml single cream.

steps.title: Pour
steps.text: Pour the custard evenly over the croissant pieces and press lightly so they soak it up, then scatter over 25 g flaked almonds.

steps.title: Rest
steps.text: Leave at room temperature for 30 min, or cover and chill overnight.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Bake at 175 °C (155 °C fan) for 45-50 min until the custard is set, the almonds are golden and the centre reads 71 °C.

steps.title: Cool
steps.text: Leave in the dish for 15-25 min before serving.

steps.title: Finish
steps.text: Dust with 1 tbsp icing sugar through a sieve and serve in scoops with 60 ml maple syrup.

tips: If soaking overnight, bake straight from the fridge and add about 5 min to the time.
Use a thermometer to check the centre reaches 71 °C before taking it out of the oven.
Let the bake settle for the full resting time so it holds together when scooped.
storage: Keeps covered in the fridge for a couple of days; warm individual portions through in the oven before serving. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
